source_law_text: The operator of a bus, other than a tour bus, shall: Not stand or park such vehicle upon any street at any place other than a bus stop, bus stand or the origin or destination point for the route to which such vehicle is assigned which has been designated in accordance with Section 11.60.010 [DEF-LVMC-11-60-010] of this Chapter.
